description: Returns the nodes of one bundle in order — the central node full, the supporting nodes terse — with citations and a cite-as line per node, on one settlement at the quoted price (a flat $0.05 for every bundle, band included; USDC on Base over x402). Pass the bundle id from bf_resolve or bf_catalogue, and a band to add the scale band for the business's revenue. Call it after bf_resolve has quoted the bundle and the user accepts the price; the quote's url is the same resource over HTTP. Do not call it to browse: the quote already lists the nodes and the price, and a narrow question is cheaper node by node through bf_read_node.

band.description: A scale band to add, by slug ("1-5m") or label ("$1–5M"); omit for the bundle without a band.

bundle.description: Bundle id from bf_resolve or bf_catalogue, e.g. "runway"; the quote url is accepted too.

name: bf_read_bundle

outputSchema.description: The bundle's nodes in order — the central node full, the rest terse — each with its text, variant, role and cite_as; one settlement at the quoted flat price.

title: Business Frameworks: read a quoted bundle
